about: Games that must never be imported by the LaxNumbers game job or scripts/import-laxnumbers-games.js. Checked before every insert. Matched by season, date and the unordered pair of team slugs, so a home/away flip on the source page still matches. An entry whose team slugs do not exist stops the script (a ruling that cannot match is a stale ruling).

rows.why: Borah's ROAD game at Bend, a 13-12 Borah win at Oregon's mt_view, already recorded by OHSLA (#243). Our NAME lookup attached it to Idaho's Mountain View; LaxNumbers' page links the right team (t=12983, Oregon's feed). The resulting row (#96806) was deleted by this ruling. Kept as a guard now that opponents resolve by team number. Corrected 2026-11-14; see docs/data-quirks.md.
